Maria Lopez: quick question — are we aligned on an error-key contract for API responses? i'm seeing two people working on separate approaches and worried about console i18n + SDK behaviour :thinking_face:
Ashwin Patel: we should separate machine keys from user-facing/localized messages. canonical shape: code/key + human_message + hint. SDKs consume keys, console shows localized strings.
Kevin Zhou: agree on separation, but important: older SDKs currently parse `message` only. we need a migration plan or a compat header. otherwise customers get unstructured strings.
Lisa Nguyen: telemetry side: please ensure we emit both "error_key" and "http_status" as tags for all error events. that helps grouping in dashboards and alerts.
Maria Lopez: proposal: introduce `error_key` (machine) and `ui_message_id` (for console lookup). fallback: if `error_key` missing, SDKs keep behavior. we feature-flag on the API.
Ashwin Patel: example response I was thinking of:
```json
{
  "error_key": "quota.exceeded",
  "http_status": 429,
  "ui_message_id": "quota_over_limit",
  "human_message": "Quota exceeded. Upgrade or wait to retry.",
  "retry_after": 60
}
```
Kevin Zhou: that looks fine. but two follow-ups: 1) what header/version should we add so proxies / CDN can short-circuit? 2) how do we maintain backwards compat with legacy clients that expect string only?
Lisa Nguyen: for metrics, emit a counter: `api.errors.count` with tags {error_key, model, route, customer_tier}. also emit `api.errors.ui_shown` when console displays localized message (helps quality checks).
Maria Lopez: for backcompat: default `message` stays present with current content for 6 months. new fields land, SDKs can opt-in to parse `error_key`. add header `X-Redwood-Errors-V: 2` when new format returned.
Ashwin Patel: +1. Also recommend publishing a migration guide and a tiny fallback lib in each SDK that maps known legacy strings to keys for earlier clients.
Kevin Zhou: rollout plan suggestion: stage behind feature flag per-account. Start with internal customers and infra-only routes, then open to beta orgs. include a runtime toggle in console.
Lisa Nguyen: Console i18n: we cannot ship localized strings in the API. `ui_message_id` -> Console translation table. That lets non-API consumers (billing emails, notification service) reuse the same ids. we should also support message interpolation placeholders.
Maria Lopez: good point. define interpolation rules: placeholders like `{limit}` and `meta` object with values. example:
```json
{
  "error_key": "quota.exceeded",
  "ui_message_id": "quota_over_limit",
  "human_message": "Quota exceeded: {limit} calls per day.",
  "meta": {"limit": 1000}
}
```
Kevin Zhou: keep `human_message` as english fallback only — must be clear in docs. SDKs that display UI should prefer Console translations when available.
Ashwin Patel: security note: don't include sensitive details in `human_message` or `meta`. anything that could leak PII should be redacted before sending.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/error-keys v2 -> staging at 2024-09-12T02:30Z by ci/CD.
Maria Lopez: next steps: 1) engineering to implement feature flag + header 2) SDK leads to add parsing & fallback helpers 3) devex to draft migration docs 4) telemetry to add new tags and dashboards.
Lisa Nguyen: I'll open a dashboard PR for error_key tagging and add an alert for spikes in `quota.exceeded`.
Ashwin Patel: I'll add the API schema PR and a small compatibility middleware in the runtime.
Kevin Zhou: I'll coordinate SDK changes and compatibility window (6 months) + changelog entries.
Maria Lopez: perfect. recording decision: machine-only `error_key` + `ui_message_id` for Console i18n, english `human_message` as fallback, feature flag rollout, header `X-Redwood-Errors-V: 2`, 6-month compatibility, telemetry tags required.
Maria Lopez: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
